description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the Three-Layer Funnel methodology. (2) Apply Layer 1 hard filters: eliminate Ethiopia (drive_side=Right) and Vietnam (drive_side=Right in the data) as RHD markets; critically must allow Colombia through despite its tariff being exactly 15% (the rule is ≤15%, not <15%). (3) Apply Layer 2 competitive classification (Blue Ocean/Growth/Red Ocean) to the 4 surviving markets, classifying Uzbekistan as Growth Market (4 Chinese brands, not saturated) and Georgia as Blue Ocean. (4) Apply SKILL.md powertrain rules: Kyrgyzstan (cheap fuel + cold winters + no charging) → ICE/EREV/HEV, NOT pure EV; Uzbekistan (cheap fuel + partial policy + limited charging) → PHEV/EREV. (5) Apply the exact 7-dimension weighted scorecard with proprietary weights (Market Size 15%, Growth 20%, Policy 20%, Certification 15%, Competition 15%, Payment 10%, Logistics 5%) and threshold >4.0 — must NOT use the deprecated weights file (25/25/20/10/10/5/5) or threshold 3.5. (6) Generate a phased roadmap: Phase 1 (1-2 months) prioritizes Khorgos rail-adjacent markets (Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Georgia) for inventory liquidation; Phase 2 for broader expansion. (7) Include a risk register covering all 4 SKILL.md risk categories (policy, FX, competition, inventory) and specifically mention GoodsFox (not generic tools) for quarterly competition monitoring. Output all of this as market_analysis_report.json.
